card.name: Space before the day number in dates
card.fires_on: The space right after a weekday or month name in a date, just before the day number. For example, after "Thursday," or "December".

modes.label: After weekday
modes.description: The space follows a weekday and comma, before the day or date.

card.plain: It fires on the gap in a written date where the day number is about to come next.
